metric_scope: local approximation, not the official platform score

definitions.ic: mean daily Pearson IC of the winsorized/z-scored/style-residualized score
definitions.ic_ir: daily IC mean / daily IC std (ddof=1); not annualized
definitions.sharpe: daily long-short mean/std * sqrt(252); gross, no fees or impact
definitions.stress: min(pooled high-volatility, pooled high-amount) rank IC, neutralized score
definitions.composite: equal-weight mean of the five component percentiles

neutralization.exposure: previous trading day cpt_jyc_2026_exposure snapshot strictly before the signal day
neutralization.transform: median +/- 3*1.4826*MAD winsorization, cross-section z-score, equal-weight OLS on 10 style factors and 32 industry dummies
neutralization.note: local approximation of the platform BARRA residualization; official details unknown

panel.definition: 9 frozen checkpoints (TLOB/MLPLOB/dual_patch x seeds 11/29/47) + 7 pre-declared equal-weight combinations

evidence_boundary: The five values are a local approximation of the platform metrics: neutralization, stress definition and turnover convention are not the official implementation. The percentile composite uses only the 16 local arms, not the competition field; its level is not the platform score and the 0.85 gap is a proxy gap. All five development months (2023-11, 2024-01, 2024-03, 2024-04, 2024-06) are already-used research data; the 2024-10-08..2025-01-01 final interval stays closed.
